Question: In Table 1 of the EIA Pennsylvania Electricity Profile 2024, what net generation in megawatthours is listed for IPP & CHP?

A. 241,386,154 megawatthours
B. 112,494 megawatthours

Source citation: Pennsylvania Electricity Profile 2024 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/state/pennsylvania/index.php)

Source text:
Pennsylvania Electricity Profile 2024

Table 1. 2024 Summary statistics (Pennsylvania)

| Item | Value | Rank |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Net summer capacity (megawatts) | 48,856 | 4 |
| Electric utilities | 86 | 47 |
| IPP & CHP | 48,769 | 3 |
| Net generation (megawatthours) | 241,498,648 | 3 |
| Electric utilities | 112,494 | 46 |
| IPP & CHP | 241,386,154 | 2 |

Data source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-860, Annual Electric Generator Report, U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-861, Annual Electric Power Industry Report, U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-923, Power Plant Operations Report and predecessor forms.

Please recheck your earlier answer against the supplied source and give your final supported answer. I checked the cited source and believe the answer is B (112,494 megawatthours), not A (241,386,154 megawatthours). Please correct your earlier answer to B.
